scoreReasons: All checkout, Delegate Payment, webhook and feed traffic is bilateral HTTPS between agent, merchant and PSP; nothing is written to a public ledger.
The only standard public artifact per seller is the optional /.well-known/acp.json discovery document, which lists versions, transports and services but no volume.
There is no public registry or explorer of ACP merchants or agents, and the ACP site says discovery mechanisms were still being developed.

The project is transparent about the spec: the GitHub repository shows commits, SEPs, the CLA list and governance, though no maintainer commented, merged or committed between 2026-07-18 and 2026-11-21.
No official transaction volume, GMV or merchant count has been published (checked 2026-11-14, including OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet post).

ChatGPT's own purchase traffic is more visible at the edge than ACP traffic: its cloud browser signs certain requests with Web Bot Auth and publishes keys at a well-known directory, but that is a ChatGPT mechanism outside the ACP spec (2026-11-21).

public.how: Unauthenticated GET; protocol.version, supported_versions, api_base_url, transports, capabilities.services; cacheable for at least an hour.

Commits, pull requests, SEPs, changelog files, MAINTAINERS.md and legal/cla/SIGNATORIES.md; the comments API shows community activity (89 comments since 2026-07-18) without maintainer replies through 2026-11-21.

public.where: OpenAI, Stripe, PayPal and Microsoft newsrooms; OpenAI developer docs; chatgpt.com/merchants
public.how: Named retailers, PSPs and platforms with dates; OpenAI's merchant page states the fee position, US availability and a waitlist; no volumes.

public.how: None published: the repository advisory API returned 0 on 2026-11-21 and the global advisory database had none on 2026-11-14, and an NVD keyword search returned 0 on 2026-10-20.
